# Project build overlay for nmeum/android-tools 37.0.0 (Apache-2.0).
# Only adb and its dependencies; no fastboot, filesystem tools, or tests.
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
add_compile_definitions(_DARWIN_C_SOURCE __DARWIN_C_LEVEL=__DARWIN_C_FULL _FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64)
add_compile_options(-Wno-attributes -ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(boringssl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(fmtlib EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
find_package(Protobuf REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
include_directories(${ADB_GTEST_INCLUDE} ${PROTOBUF_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
include(CheckSymbolExists)
check_symbol_exists(strlcpy "string.h" HAVE_STRLCPY)
check_symbol_exists(reallocarray "stdlib.h" HAVE_REALLOCARRAY)
foreach(component brotlicommon brotlidec brotlienc lz4 zstd)
  find_library(${component}_LIBRARY NAMES ${component} PATHS "${ADB_DEPS_PREFIX}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
  add_library(PkgConfig::lib${component} STATIC IMPORTED)
  set_target_properties(PkgConfig::lib${component} PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${${component}_LIBRARY}" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${ADB_DEPS_PREFIX}/include")
endforeach()
set(ANDROID_TOOLS_USE_BUNDLED_LIBUSB ON)
# Keep libusb replaceable under LGPL-2.1; upstream defaults to STATIC.
include(CMakeLists.libusb.txt)
set_target_properties(android_tools_libusb PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME usb-1.0 SOVERSION 0 VERSION 0.5.0)
include(CMakeLists.libbase.txt)
include(CMakeLists.adb.txt)
# adb uses libzip, which upstream defines in the fastboot file.
add_library(libzip STATIC libziparchive/zip_archive.cc libziparchive/zip_archive_stream_entry.cc libziparchive/zip_cd_entry_map.cc libziparchive/zip_error.cpp libziparchive/zip_writer.cc)
target_compile_definitions(libzip PRIVATE ZLIB_CONST)
target_include_directories(libzip PUBLIC libziparchive/include libziparchive/incfs_support/include core/include logging/liblog/include libbase/include)
target_sources(libadb PRIVATE adb/adb_mdns.cpp "${ADB_RECIPE_DIR}/mdns_disabled.cpp")
